built_by: The guarded workflow .github/workflows/fly-pilot.yml, run 35825420925, dispatched on main with operation deploy, after the continuous integration run 35824162536 passed on this exact revision. The Machine took the new image at 2026-09-23T06:10:54Z. Every workflow step passed, including the readiness poll, the catalogue grant step and the host billing policy step on the Machine.

what_this_release_changes: The engine framework, wave A: engine records, the catalogue of 45 engine slots, live dependency guards, the harness recipe catalogue and the step executor adapter contract, under core/engines and core/step_execution. Catalogue releases without a redeploy: a content-addressed body store, releases with an active pointer and durable withdrawals, an attribute schema defined as data, search filters, grants that can follow the active release, and five new service commands (publish-catalogue, rollback-catalogue, withdraw-catalogue-item, catalogue-status, follow-catalogue-release); health gains catalogue_view_current and reports the served catalogue. The data cleanup demonstration and its negative result. The starter catalogue anchored to 40fce69.
